## Outcome

Task ID and the single user-visible or technical result.

## Dependencies and baseline

Completed dependency IDs; source/data revision relevant to this task.
Link to the existing roadmap row. Do not create a second competing task queue.

## Scope

Behaviors/files expected to change. Explicit boundaries that keep this review small.
If several unrelated outcomes are necessary, split this task before implementation.

## Acceptance checks

- [ ] Observable result and meaningful expected behavior.
- [ ] Focused reference/native/UI/offline checks appropriate to the change.
- [ ] State saved/reopened or reversed correctly where relevant.
- [ ] Evidence recorded, roadmap and STATUS updated.

## Evidence and handover

Actual commands/check links, commit or PR, unresolved limitations, and one next
task. Do not mark unexecuted or placeholder checks as passing.
